verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an auditor role, auditor portal, or scoped auditor view of controls and evidence. The closest items are a notifications feed that mentions "audit activity" and generic claims of automating the SOC 2 process, which are adjacent and do not show auditors working inside the platform. The axis clearly applies to a compliance automation platform, so the absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs
